build_conv_bn_act_layer: build a ConvBnActLayer with configurable kernel size, stride, and activation function for CNN blocks
build_mb_inverted_conv_layer: build an MBInvertedConvLayer with expand ratio, SE attention, and depthwise convolution for MobileNet blocks
build_mobile_inverted_residual_block: build a MobileInvertedResidualBlock combining an inverted convolution with a shortcut and drop connect
build_se_layer: build an SELayer squeeze-and-excitation module that applies channel-wise attention to feature maps
set_layer_from_config: create any static layer from a config dictionary using set_layer_from_config factory function
